name: Gabyouden
source:
Humanity advances into space, builds new civilizations and attracts attention of aliens.
Girl Eko suddenly speaks to girl Kinu and announces that aliens start to invade the planet, but to oppose them girls need to perform a synchronized special attack to target limited wavelength. Will life on the planet persist in the end?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人类进军太空，建立新的文明，并引起了外星人的注意。
女孩埃科突然与女孩基努说话，并宣布外星人开始入侵地球，但为了对抗他们，女孩们需要对有限的波长进行同步特殊攻击。地球上的生命最终会持续存在吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
